name: forest
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original website artwork, no lettering, no logos, no existing characters or copied film scenes. Exquisite hand painted watercolor and gouache on textured paper, cinematic Japanese storybook background painting, painterly depth, rich midnight teal, sage and olive, warm gold highlights. Companion character always a small round cream-colored cat, olive-green neckerchief, one tiny yellow flower beside its left ear. Landscape 3:2 composition, high quality.
A winding path through lush nighttime woodland to a tiny cottage with glowing amber windows in the background. Ferns and small yellow wildflowers foreground, scattered golden fireflies, crescent moon. Cream cat with olive scarf and yellow ear flower waiting on path, lower right. Left half relatively dark calm foliage for optional overlaid typography; no actual text. Dreamy, inviting, detailed, intimate.
